title: Cisco Identity Services Engine IpAccessFilter Direct Request Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass IP restrictions on affected installations of Cisco Identity Services Engine. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the configuration of the web.xml file. The issue results from an incomplete Spring Boot filter mapping. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass IP restrictions on the system.
